$comment: Misconception catalogue. 'implicates' lists skills whose weakness this misconception is evidence of; the detour planner intersects it with the prerequisite closure of the failed skill. Awaiting named human review with the templates that use these tags.

misconceptions.description: Gives the period when the frequency is asked.
Gives oscillations per second when the period is asked.

flashcard.front: n oscillations in t seconds: period?

misconceptions.description: Uses the difference of the periods as the time to be in phase again.

flashcard.front: Two pendulums T₁ < T₂: next time in phase?
flashcard.back: When the faster one has made one extra oscillation: T₁T₂ ÷ (T₂ − T₁).

misconceptions.description: Uses sin φ for x(0) when x = A cos(ωt + φ).

flashcard.front: x = A cos(ωt + φ): x at t = 0?

misconceptions.description: Gives the amplitude as the displacement at an instant.

flashcard.back: Only if φ = 0: x(0) = A cos φ.

misconceptions.description: Uses cos(t ÷ T) instead of cos(2πt ÷ T).
Uses the inverse sine to find a phase in x = A cos(ωt + φ).

flashcard.back: cos⁻¹(x₀ ÷ A), with its sign set by the direction of motion.

misconceptions.description: Ignores the direction of motion when choosing the phase.

flashcard.front: Two phases give the same x(0). How to choose?
flashcard.back: Use the velocity: v(0) = −Aω sin φ.

misconceptions.description: Mixes up Aω (maximum speed) and Aω² (maximum acceleration).

flashcard.front: Maximum speed and acceleration in SHM?

misconceptions.description: Uses ω x or ω(A − x) for the speed at x.

flashcard.front: Speed at displacement x in SHM?

misconceptions.description: Uses f instead of ω = 2πf.
Uses centimetres in F = kx.

flashcard.front: F = kx with x in cm?

misconceptions.description: Writes T = 2π√(k ÷ m).
Leaves out 2π in the spring period.
Mixes up the combination rules for springs.

flashcard.front: Two identical springs side by side (parallel): k_eff?

misconceptions.description: Ignores the second spring.

flashcard.front: Does a second parallel spring change the period?
flashcard.back: Yes: k_eff = 2k, so T falls by √2.

misconceptions.description: Writes the energy of SHM as kA².
Uses A instead of A² in the energy.
Gives the potential energy when the kinetic energy is asked.

flashcard.front: KE at displacement x in SHM?

misconceptions.description: Thinks KE = PE at half the amplitude.

flashcard.front: Where is KE = PE in SHM?

misconceptions.description: Writes T = 2π√(g ÷ L).
Leaves out the square root in the pendulum period.
Uses T instead of T² when solving for L.
Expects a pendulum to swing faster where g is smaller.
Scales the period linearly with g.
